reason: $45 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and I wait for coupons before trying anything. I might use the free first visit, but I would not pay a membership or a $14 drop-in for two kids on a regular basis.
objection: Two kids means $14 + $7 every visit, and the park and library cost nothing. I would not pay that every week.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or similar deal, like a few visits for under $30, plus proof after the free visit that my 4-year-old and the baby both stay happy there.
